name: Hosoi Yoshiko
source:
The protagonist of the "Desire to Lose Weight" scenario. 20 years old. Part-time worker. She has a strong appetite and is overweight, which her boyfriend Yoichi has pointed out to her. She starts an insane diet to lose 17 kg in 5 days, hoping that he won't dump her. She has an optimistic and cheerful personality, but once she feels down, she can become extremely depressed or become so ecstatic that she can't see anything else around her. When she eats something delicious, she has a habit of looking pleased and her eyes focus on her brow.
Her hobbies and special skills are eating. She is a Leo.

[From [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/街_〜運命の交差点〜]Wikipedia[/url]]
